title: Business-Wrap diagram model
description: The model of a document block {kind:'diagram', caption, model}. engine/diagram.mjs draws it (house workflow look) as SVG shapes with real text for the editor and the PDF, and as native Word shapes for the DOCX. A node without x/y is placed by the auto layout; edges are routed from the node geometry (orthogonal, rounded corners) unless they carry hand-set bend points (via). Edits change it with the edits contract: {op:'replace', path:'<block>/model', value:<model>} or setText on <block>/model/nodes/<i>/label.

flow.description: Direction of the chain (the house reference runs left to right in both editions).

legend.description: false hides the legend; an object renames entries by key (staff, applicant, rework, payment, system, stop, ok, note, wire-main, wire-return, wire-stop).

color.description: Theme colour role; absent = the kind's own.

icons.description: Badges; absent = the kind's own, [] = none.

auto.description: A group band the auto layout made (rebuilt on re-layout).

kind.description: main = solid forward path, return = dashed brown, stop = thin red refusal. Absent = derived (to a refusal end = stop; backwards or via rework = return).

label.description: May hold a line feed (Shift+Enter in the editor) for a hand-made line break.

via.description: Bend points [x, y] set by hand between the two ends; the router keeps every segment orthogonal (an elbow is added where an end moved). Absent = automatic routing.
